theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W F B : Set (Euclid P)) (T Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (C S Ŷ Sr Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (e : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → IsIntegerMultiplicity Z → IsOpen B → B ⊆ U → IsOpen W → IsCompact F → W ⊆ F → F ⊆ B → R.measure (F \ W) = 0 → (S - C).support ⊆ W → IsIntegerMultiplicity Ŷ → Ŷ.support ⊆ F → (∀ R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R'.Represents Ŷ → R'.measure (F \ W) ≤ e) → Sr.mass ≤ e → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ W → C ω = currentEval T (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) + Ŷ ω + Sr ω) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Y ω = (S - C) ω + Ŷ ω) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Z ω = T ω + Y (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) n ω)) → ∃ b : ℝ≥0∞, T.massOn B = T.massOn W + b ∧ Z.massOn B ≤ S.massOn W + e + e + b
